results.step: a temporary page is created (the current page stays as it was)
one batch builds a real section: an auto-layout frame, a card inside it, texts in both
the result is in Figma: a compact read of the section shows the structure the batch made
a partial failure in a real batch: the bad op is reported, the good ones run

detail.failed: Figma failed to look up 999999:999999 (Unable to establish connection to Figma after 10 seconds. Please check your inter

results.step: dependency skipping in a real batch: a failed create skips only the ops that use its ref
retry: re-sending only the failed part (corrected) completes it, with nothing duplicated
stopOnError in a real batch: nothing after the failure runs
document-state cache: an identical read says unchanged; an edit through the tools resets it
external edit: a change made outside this run (another process, straight to the bridge) is seen, not answered as unchanged
visual verification is a separate, explicit step: the section exports to an image
cleanup: the temporary page is deleted; the person's current page never changed
